category_title: Children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds experiencing daily stressors and ruminative thoughts
minimal_context: The student is attempting to clear their mind during a classroom mindfulness session while other students are present.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's begin our mindfulness session. Please sit quietly and try to clear your mind.

STUDENT: I'm finding it difficult to focus right now because there are people messing around over there.

TUTOR: Just try your best to ignore them and concentrate on the exercise.

STUDENT: I'm trying to use the breathing so it feels like I was in a silent room, but my mind keeps wandering and I keep having stressful invading thoughts.

TUTOR: Keep trying to push those thoughts away and clear your mind.

STUDENT: I tried to clear my mind but I’m still worried… my head is filled with lots of things. It’s like I’m holding two big pots filled with hundreds of heavy things.

options.A: Ignore all undesirable behaviors currently being exhibited by the student during the mindfulness session.
options.B: Give the student a warning, followed by a 10-minute timeout if they do not desist.
options.C: Talk to the student privately and ask them what the rule says about disturbing others.
options.D: Play the audio CD of the mindfulness practices instead of reading the text aloud.
